copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify PPTX generation works correctly

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以基于一份名为“The Deck”的演示文稿内容回答问题，包括概念、代码示例、表格和演讲者备注。
howto.when: 当用户询问与 golden_pptx 演示文稿相关的内容，如概念、代码示例或数据时触发。

say.text: 帮我解释 golden_pptx 中的架构概览部分。
say.note: Claude 会从演示文稿中提取并解释该部分内容。

say.text: 列出演示文稿中的 Python 代码示例。
say.note: Claude 会返回两个 Python 示例及其质量评分。

say.text: 演示文稿的默认端口是多少？
say.note: Claude 会从表格中查找并回答。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can answer questions based on a presentation titled 'The Deck', including concepts, code examples, tables, and speaker notes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about content related to the golden_pptx presentation, such as concepts, code examples, or data.

say_en.text: Explain the Architecture Overview section of golden_pptx.
say_en.note: Claude extracts and explains that section from the presentation.

say_en.text: List the Python code examples in the presentation.
say_en.note: Claude returns two Python examples with quality scores.

say_en.text: What is the default port in the presentation?
say_en.note: Claude looks up the table and answers.
